description: Change a viewer's view options: magnification (zoom percent, 100 for actual size), the Show Channel menu (RGB, red, green, blue, alpha, colorized, straight RGB; alpha boundary and overlay in the Layer panel), exposure, the transparency grid, Fast Previews (Off, Adaptive Resolution, Draft, Fast Draft, Wireframe), rulers, guides (show, snap, lock), which view is active, and maximizing the panel. Also the composition's resolution (Full, Half, Third, Quarter, Custom) and pausing viewer updates (Caps Lock)

channel.description: Show Channel. alpha_boundary and alpha_overlay are Layer panel only

comp.description: Open this composition in the Composition panel and use that viewer (item id or name). Omit both comp and layer for the focused viewer

customResolution.description: Custom resolution: render every Nth pixel across and down

layer.description: Open this layer (1-based, in comp or the active composition) in the Layer panel and use that viewer

maximized.description: Maximize the viewer panel, or restore it

pauseViewerUpdates.description: Stop viewers redrawing, as Caps Lock does

resolution.description: Composition resolution (down-sample factor); custom takes customResolution

view.description: Make this view (1-based, in a two- or four-view layout) active and change it. Default the active view

name: set_view_options
title: Set View Options
